blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
In response to the growing demand for long sequences in agentic and reasoning use cases, many state-of-the-art LLMs combine multiple variants of attention to mitigate the quadratic complexity of traditional softmax attention.
These hybrid attention LLMs aim to balance the strengths and limitations of full attention and alternatives based on recurrence. This work presents a first study of how hybrid attention impacts the multilinguality of LLMs.
Beyond the impact on long sequences in poorly tokenized languages, our study is motivated by the possibility that the inductive biases of the recurrent state alter linguistic processing.
Our interpretability analysis confirms this, showing that cross-lingual representations in hybrid models develop in patterns tied to the ordering of recurrent and full-attention layers.
Across diverse models, we notably observe a pronounced spike in cross-lingual alignment around the first full-attention layer.
These findings lead us to question the conventional ordering of attention layers.
In distillation experiments on multilingual data, all alternative layer orderings outperform the standard throughout training, learning up to 2.5X faster.
These stark, replicable results prompt our theory that multilingual models would benefit from starting with a full-attention layer rather than recurrent layers.
blocks.zh:
针对代理和推理案例对长序列日益增长的需求,许多最先进的LLMS结合了多种关注的变体,以缓解传统软马克思关注的四极复杂性.
这些混合关注的LLMS旨在平衡充分关注的长处和局限以及基于重复的替代方法. 这项工作首次研究了混合关注如何影响法学硕士的多语性。
除了对语言符号化程度低的长序列的影响外,我们的研究还受到反复出现的状态的诱导偏差改变语言处理的可能性的推动。
我们的可解释性分析证实了这一点,表明混合模型中的跨语言表达方式与反复和全心全意层的顺序挂钩。
在各种模式中,我们特别看到,第一全注意层周围的跨语言对齐明显激增。
这些调查结果使我们对传统的关注层次顺序提出质疑。
在多语种数据的蒸馏实验中,所有替代层的订单都超过了整个训练的标准,学习速度可达2.5X.
这些严酷、可复制的成果促使我们提出一个理论,即从全心全意的层次开始,而不是从重复的层次开始,多语种模式将是有益的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The tasks we rely on LLMs for have become increasingly complex, demanding autonomous planning, tool-calling, large-scale data retrieval, and more.
These workflows accumulate massive contexts, making the O ⁡ ( T 2 ) O(T^{2}) computational cost of full softmax attention (where T T is sequence length) a growing bottleneck.
Hybrid attention models address this pressure by combining full attention with recurrent mechanisms that scale linearly in T T . Hybridization has become the leading paradigm among state-of-the-art open-weight models, including Kimi K3 and the Nemotron, Qwen, and MiniMax families ( Team et al., 2026 ; NVIDIA: et al., 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ; MiniMax et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们依赖有限责任公司的任务变得越来越复杂,要求自主规划、调用工具、大规模数据检索等等。
这些工作流程积累了巨大的上下文,使得O QQ(T 2 ) O(T QQ2 ) 完全软马克思关注(T是序列长度)的计算成本成为不断增长的瓶颈.
混合关注模式通过将充分关注与线性地在T T 中扩展的重复机制相结合来解决这种压力。 混合型已经成为Kimi K3和Nemotron,Quen和MiniMax家族等最先进的开放量级模型中的主要范例(Team等人,2026年;NVIDIA:等人,2025年;Quen Team,2026年;MiniMax等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Its strengths extend beyond efficiency: combining recurrence and attention can yield greater expressivity than either mechanism alone, leading to significantly improved pretraining ( Waleffe et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) .
These mechanisms have distinct inductive biases: recurrent layers maintain a compressed, evolving state, while full attention directly accesses all earlier token representations.
These differences may affect how models process linguistic form and build internal abstractions. Yet how hybrid attention LLMs organize these processes amongst this heterogeneity remains understudied ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Afendulev et al., 2026 ) .
Understanding this organization can clarify the strengths and limitations of hybridization and guide future model design.
blocks.zh:
它的长处超越了效率:结合重现和注意力可以产生比两个机制都更大的表达力,从而大大改善了预训(Waleffe等人,2024年;Merrill等人,2026年)。
这些机制具有明显的诱导性偏差:反复层保持一个压缩的,不断演变的状态,而充分关注则直接访问所有早期的象征性表述.
这些差异可能影响模型如何处理语言形式和构建内部抽象. 然而,在这种异质性中,如何混合关注LLMS组织这些过程仍然没有得到充分的研究(Shen等人,2026年;Afendulev等人,2026年)。
了解这个组织可以澄清混合化的优点和局限性,并指导未来的模型设计.

blocks.en:
Multilinguality is both an essential model capability and a valuable lens on model internals.
LLMs must serve users and process information across languages, a requirement that extends even to long-horizon autonomous agents deployed on real-world data ( Caciolai et al., 2026 ) . However, no prior work has studied how recurrent attention and hybridization impact multilingual processing.
Beyond being a major use case, cross-lingual data offers unique insight into model computations.
Comparing equivalent content across languages helps distinguish processing tied to surface form from more abstract representations shared across languages ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Bandarkar et al., 2026a ) .
We therefore use multilinguality to study how hybrid LLMs organize computation.
blocks.zh:
多重性既是基本的模型能力,也是模型内部的有价值的透镜.
LLM必须服务用户和处理跨语言的信息,这一要求甚至延伸到部署在现实世界数据上的长视野自主代理(Caciolai等人,2026年)。 然而,以前没有研究过反复关注和混合处理如何影响多语种处理。
跨语言数据不仅是一个主要的应用案例,而且还为模型计算提供了独特的见解。
比较各种语言的等同内容有助于区分与表面形式相联系的处理和各种语言之间共享的更为抽象的表述(Lee等人,2025年;Bandarkar等人,2026年a) 。 。 。
因此,我们利用多种语言研究混合法学硕士如何组织计算。

blocks.en:
In this work, we study four hybrid models alongside close non-hybrid counterparts. Because these pairs are not perfectly comparable, our analysis extends deeper than benchmark results.
In Section 4 , we examine how token inflation makes long-sequence efficiency especially consequential for multilingual inputs, separating the ability to accommodate longer sequences from the ability to retrieve their contents. Hybrid attention offers large efficiency gains on multilingual inputs, while its retrieval shortcomings actually lessen as contexts grow.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们研究了四种杂交模型,以及密切的非杂交模型。 因为这些对子不完全可比,我们的分析比基准结果更深入。
在第4节中,我们研究象征性通货膨胀如何使长序列效率对多语种投入特别产生后果,将容纳较长序列的能力与检索其内容的能力区分开来。 混合关注为多语种投入带来了巨大的效率收益,而随着环境的增长,其检索缺陷实际上有所缓解。

blocks.en: Then in Section 5 , we trace layer-wise representational patterns and their relationship to attention ordering. We show that in comparison to the smooth development of language-abstract representations exhibited in full attention models (and also in SWA-hybrid models), hybrid attention models exhibit much more abrupt changes around interleaved full attention layers. In particular, we identify a pronounced reorganization around the first occurrence of full-attention.
blocks.zh: 然后在第5节中,我们追踪到层层的表达模式 以及它们的关系 以关注顺序。 我们显示,与在全注意力模型(以及SWA-hybrid模型)中展现的语言抽象表现的平稳发展相比,混合注意力模型围绕全注意力层的相互间变化要大得多。 特别是,我们发现围绕第一次全心全意的出现进行了明显的重组。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these patterns, in Section 6 we question the status quo of layer ordering adopted by major labs: periodically interleaving full-attention layers after recurrent layers. Rationale for these layer orderings is scarce, and multilinguality was likely not a primary consideration.
We evaluate four alternative orderings by training hybrid models by distilling from a full-attention teacher LLMs. All of them comfortably outperform the conventional periodic layout on multilingual data. The only characteristic shared by all five is that the first layer is full attention. And while pretraining from scratch is a very different setting, we formulate the theory that multilingual LLMs should start with full softmax attention.
blocks.zh:
受这些模式的驱使,我们在第6节中质疑各大实验室采用的层序现状:在重复层之后,定期将层层完全分离。 这些层次命令的理由很少,多种语文可能不是首要考虑。
我们通过从全心全意的教师课程中提炼出混合模型来评估四种替代订单。 它们都比传统多语种数据的定期布局好。 所有五个人共有的唯一特征是第一层是充分关注. 虽然从头开始的预训是一个非常不同的环境, 我们提出一个理论, 即多语言的LLM应该从全软马克思的注意力开始。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Research in Attention Alternatives
blocks.zh: 2.1 注意力替代品研究

blocks.en: The attention mechanism ( Bahdanau et al., 2015 ) was originally introduced to address the long-sequence performance bottleneck of recurrent neural networks like LSTMs ( Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997 ) , which are constrained by the size of the state. However, transformer models ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) suffer from quadratic asymptotic complexity O ⁡ ( T 2 ) O(T^{2}) with respect to sequence length T T because of the 𝑸 ​ 𝑲 T \displaystyle{\bm{Q}}{\bm{K}}^{T} operation. Popular solutions proposed to achieve linear complexity O ⁡ ( T ) O(T) were to use low-rank matrix approximations ( Wang et al., 2020 ) or sliding-windows (SWA) ( Beltagy et al., 2020 ) . Notably, the FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) implementation of full attention achieves linear complexity of peak-memory consumption, even if computational complexity remains quadratic.
blocks.zh: 关注机制(Bahdanau等人,2015年)最初是用来解决LSTMs(Hochreiter和Schmidhuber,1997年)等反复出现的神经网络的长序性能瓶颈,这些神经网络受到州大小的限制. 然而,变压器模型(Vaswani等人,2017年)由于Q K T\displaystyle\bm{K}}^{T}操作,在序列长度T T上出现四极不对称复杂性O (T 2)O^{(T^{2}). 为实现线性复杂性而提出的大众解决方案 O QQ(T) O(T)是使用低级矩阵近似值(Wang等人,2020年)或滑窗(SWA)(Beltagy等人,2020年). 值得注意的是,全面关注的FlashAttention(Dao等人,2022年)的实施实现了峰值-记忆消耗的线性复杂性,即使计算复杂性仍然是四极性.

blocks.en: However, Katharopoulos et al. (2020) showed that without the softmax operator, self-attention could be reduced via matrix associativity to a linear-complexity recurrence relation. This prompted a line of research that seeks to reach attention-level expressivity and parallelization while maintaining linear complexity, including selective state-space models ( Gu and Dao, 2024 ) and the Delta Rule ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . More recent recurrent attention variants, such as Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025d ) and Kimi Delta Attention ( Team et al., 2025 ) , improve the in-context learning ability of state-space models by maintaining an updatable associative key-value memory ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,Katharopoulos等人(2020年)表明,如果没有软马克斯操作器,通过矩阵共通性可以将自觉降低到线性-复合性重现关系. 这催生了一条研究线,寻求在保持线性复杂性的同时达到关注层次的表达性和平行性,包括选择性的状态空间模型(Gu and Dao, 2024)和三角洲规则(Yang等人, 2024). 较近期的经常性关注变体,如Gated DeltaNet(Yang等人,2025d)和Kimi Delta Record(Team等人,2025年),通过保持可更新的关联键值内存(Quen Team,2025年),提高了状态空间模型的内涵学习能力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Hybrid Attention LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 混合关注课程

blocks.en: Modern LLMs increasingly combine these recurrent mechanisms with occasional full-attention layers to exploit their complementary strengths ( Mehta et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2023 ; Lenz et al., 2025 ; MiniMax et al., 2025 ) . Recurrent layers offer efficient state tracking over long sequences, while full attention preserves precise content-based retrieval that is difficult to compress into a fixed-size state ( Qiao et al., 2026 ) . Beyond reducing inference costs, this combination can be more expressive and scale more efficiently during pretraining than either mechanism alone ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) . Hybridization can occur within a single attention block ( Zuo et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ) , but more commonly, the two attention architectures are interleaved in subsequent decoder layers.
blocks.zh: 现代有限责任公司越来越多地将这些反复出现的机制与不定期的全心全意层结合起来,以利用其互补优势(Mehta等人,2023年;Fu等人,2023年;Lenz等人,2025年;MiniMax等人,2025年)。 经常层在长序上提供高效的状态跟踪,而充分关注则保留精确的基于内容的检索,难以压缩成固定大小状态(Qiao等人,2026年). 除了减少推论费用外,这种组合在预训期间比任何一种机制都更具有表现力和更有效规模(Merrill等人,2026年)。 混合化可以在单一的注意力块内发生(Zuo等人,2025年;Du等人,2026年),但更常见的是,两个注意力架构在后续的解码层中互开.

blocks.en: In this work, we refer to traditional softmax attention as “full” attention and linear-complexity recurrent alternatives generally as “recurrent” attention. We categorize SWA separately, since it is linear-complexity, sparse local attention. For simplicity, we use “attention” broadly to include components such as Mamba-2, even if sequence mixers is the more general term.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们把传统的软度注意称为“充分”注意,把线性-复杂性重复性替代办法一般称为“经常”注意。 我们把西南洋分门别类,因为它是线性复杂,地方关注度低。 为了简单起见,我们广泛使用“意向”包括诸如Mamba-2等组件,即使序列搅拌器是比较笼统的术语。

blocks.en: 2.3 Multilinguality in LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.3 法学硕士学位的多重性

blocks.en:
Recent multilingual interpretability research has notably found that LLMs operate in a language-shared representations in the middle layers ( Kojima et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Dumas et al., 2025 ) . This follows language-specific detokenization ( Lad et al., 2025 ) in early layers and precedes language-specific generation in the final layers.
Analogous to this work, Bandarkar et al. (2026b) studies how the adoption of sparse mixture-of-experts layers impacts multilinguality in LLMs by designing metrics to analyze cross-lingual alignment in the MoE layer.
The attention mechanism, in contrast to the feed-forward network, provides access to previous tokens, making it essential for language-specific, low-level linguistic processing.
Prior work links attention heads to syntactic processing and multilingual performance ( Voita et al., 2019 ; Ma et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Cross-lingual fine-tuning research finds attention updates to be much more essential than FFN updates ( Bandarkar et al., 2025 ; Bandarkar and Peng, 2025 ; Tran et al., 2026 ) .
These findings generally suggest attention plays a disproportionate role in model multilinguality.
blocks.zh:
最近的多语种解释性研究发现,LLMs在中层以语言共享的表达方式运作(Kojima等人,2024年;赵等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;Dumas等人,2025年)。 这跟随语言在早期的分解(Lad等人,2025年),在最终的分层中先于语言特定一代.
与这项工作类似,Bandarkar等人(2026年b)研究了采用稀疏的混合型专家层如何通过设计衡量标准来分析教育部层的跨语言一致性,影响LLMs的多语性。
关注机制与feed-forward网络形成对比,为之前的令牌提供访问,使得语言特异性,低层次的语言处理至关重要.
先前的工作将注意力与综合处理和多语种表现联系起来(Voita等人,2019年;Ma等人,2021年;Zhang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年)。
跨文化微调研究发现,注意力更新比FFN更新更为重要(Bandarkar等人,2025年;Bandarkar和Peng,2025年;Tran等人,2026年)。
这些调查结果通常表明,注意力在多语种模式中发挥着不相称的作用。

blocks.en: 3 Models
blocks.zh: 3个模式

blocks.en: For our investigation, we analyze four hybrid-attention models with reasonably close counterparts for comparison, listed in Table 1 . While options were limited, these four pairs are diverse in size, sparsity, multilinguality, and more. Three periodically interleave full attention after 3 or 4 recurrent attention layers, while Granite-4.0-H places full attention in layers 4, 14, 24, and 34.
blocks.zh: 为了进行调查,我们分析了表1所列的四种混合关注模式,与相当接近的对应模式进行比较。 虽然选择有限,但这四对选择在大小、伸缩、多语种等方面各不相同。 三层或四层连续的注意层后,三层定期间断,而Granite-4.0-H在第四层、第十四层、第二十四层和第三十四层中放出全部注意。

blocks.en: Table 1: Hybrid-attention models studied in this work and their closest non-hybrid counterparts. In the interest of space, we provide further design details and citations for all in Appendix A . The much larger Ling-2.6-flash and SWA-hybrid Tiny Aya are also studied partially.
blocks.zh: 表1:在这项工作中研究的混合参与模式及其最接近的非混合参与模式。 为了空间起见,我们在附录A中为所有人提供进一步的设计细节和引文。 更大得多的Ling-2.6-flash和SWA-hybrid Tiny Aya也被部分研究.

blocks.en: OLMo-3 is technically a “hybrid” model since it interleaves SWA layers at a 3:1 ratio, just like Tiny Aya.
blocks.zh: OLMo-3在技术上是一种“hybrid”模型,因为它以3:1的比例将SWA层隔开,就像Tiny Aya一样。

blocks.en: Granite-4.0-h-micro uses a non-regular interleaving of four full-attention layers among 40 total; see the config .
blocks.zh: Granite-4.0-h-micro在总共40个层中使用4个全心电层的非定期对接;参见配置。

blocks.en:
The recurrent variants in these models differ primarily in how they update their recurrent states.
Lightning Attention-2 in Ring-linear accumulates key-value associations with input- independent decay. Qwen3.5’s Gated DeltaNet instead combines input-dependent forget gates with delta-rule updates.
Granite uses Mamba-2, a selective state-space model that also uses forget gates, but with additive updates.
OLMo-Hybrid uses a close variant of Gated DeltaNet ( Grazzi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
这些模型中反复出现的变体主要在如何更新其反复出现的状态上有所不同.
Ring-linear中的闪电注意-2会累积带有输入-独立衰变的键值关联. Wen3.5的三角洲 网络将依赖输入的忘却门与三角规则更新相结合.
Granite使用Mamba-2,一种选择性的状态空间模型,它也使用忘却门,但带有添加剂更新.
OLMo-Hybrid使用Gated DeltaNet(Grazzi等人,2025年)的近似变体.

blocks.en:
None of these pairs enable a flawless comparison: even though the OLMo pair’s controlled experiments are designed for comparing, its explicit exclusion of multilingual training data makes it the least useful for our purposes.
We initially compare the models on a few standard multilingual benchmarks, but find no consistent evidence of a cross-lingual transfer advantage (details in Appendix B ). Across the four pairs, hybrid models are generally stronger overall and, except for the jointly released Granite 4.0 models, were released later than their non-hybrid counterparts, complicating 1-to-1 comparisons. With matched training conditions, OLMo-Hybrid consistently performs slightly better than OLMo-3. However, when examining the multilingual gap relative to English as an indicator of cross-lingual transfer, the relative advantage varies from benchmark to benchmark. Thus, we extend our analysis past simple evaluation.
blocks.zh:
这些对子都无法进行完美无缺的比较:尽管OLMo对子的控制实验是为了比较而设计的,但明确排除多语种培训数据使得它对我们的目的用处最小。
我们最初根据几个标准的多语种基准来比较模型,但没有找到交叉语言转移优势的一致证据(详见附录B)。 在整个四对模型中,混合模型总体上一般较强,除了联合发布的Granite 4.0模型外,其发布时间晚于其非hybrid对应模型,使1比1的比较复杂化. 由于训练条件相匹配,OLMo-Hybrid的成绩一直略优于OLMo-3。 然而,在研究与英语相比的多语种差距作为跨语种传承指标时,相对优势因基准而异. 因此,我们将过去的简单评估扩大分析范围。

blocks.en: 4 Multilingual Tokenization
blocks.zh: 4 多语种化

blocks.en:
Long-sequence efficiency is particularly relevant to multilinguality because of typically poor tokenization in many languages.
Even a large-vocab tokenizer like Qwen3.5 creates sequences that are 2.6 × \times in Yoruba than English (estimated on parallel data). The English-centric OLMo explodes contexts 10 × \times in some non-Latin-script languages. So here, linear-complexity attention is critical.
blocks.zh:
长序效率与多语种特别相关,因为许多语言的象征性通常很差。
即使是像Quen3.5这样的大沃卡比标注器,也会产生在约鲁巴语中为2.6×\时的序列,而不是英语(根据平行数据估计). 以英语为中心的OLMo会在一些非拉丁语语言中爆炸上下文 10 ×\times. 因此,这里,线性-复杂性关注至关重要。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the long-context recall cost in English versus other languages using five OneRULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks ( Kim et al., 2025 ) (excluding common-word extraction), with results in Table 2 . On a single A6000 GPU with 48GB VRAM, our evaluations encountered out-of-memory (OOM) failures substantially less often for hybrid models, as expected.
At 128K, Qwen3.5 completed 25/40 language-task evaluations, compared with only one for Qwen3.
For Granite models, the 64K evaluations on the hybrid variant took considerably shorter: 13.5 hours versus 61.5.
blocks.zh:
我们使用5项OneRULER bird-in-a-Haystack任务(Kim等人,2025年)(不包括常用词提取)来评价英文和其他语文的长文本召回成本,结果见表2。 在单一的A6000GPU和48GB VRAM上,我们的评价遇到的超模(OOM)故障比预期的要少得多。
在128K时,Quen3.5完成了25/40语言任务评价,而Quen3时只有一次.
就Granite模型而言,对混合变种的64K评价耗时大大缩短:13.5小时,61.5小时。

blocks.en:
We investigate numerous approaches to understanding how cross-lingual representations evolve through the model layers.
Because of the diversity of attention implementations, our analysis treats the attention block as a black box. We focus on the hidden state entering the decoder layer (labeled as attn_in in Figure 1 ) and after the attention block; specifically, after the residual stream connection ( attn_out ). A major obstacle to measuring cross-lingual alignment from these states is that tokenization and linguistic structure prevent a one-to-one mapping of tokens across texts. Typical measurements instead mean-pool over a sequence or use only its last token. We attempt to mitigate the heavy information loss of such metrics with a metric that softly aligns tokens.
Our metric, SoftCKA, is based on centered kernel alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , which compares neural network hidden states pair-wise through the geometric similarity of the representation space instead of absolute values.
Let 𝑿 1 , 𝑿 2 {\bm{X}}_{1},{\bm{X}}_{2} be the sequences of hidden states at a particular point in the model on a pair of parallel (i.e. translated) sentences. blocks.en: 5.2 Observational Findings
blocks.zh: 5.2 观察结论

blocks.en: We start by using SoftCKA to measure representational alignment to English.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用SoftCKA来测量与英语的表达一致.

blocks.en: Finding 2 Representations are less aligned across languages in hybrid attention LLMs.
blocks.zh: 发现2 在混合关注课程中,各语文之间的代表性不太一致。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 2 , Granite-H builds significantly less aligned representations, particularly in the middle layers. The figure displays a multi-language average, but this is individually the case for all 13 languages. For Qwen models, Qwen3.5 has less cross-lingual alignment in 10/13 languages. For Ring, Ring-linear has lower alignment in 11/13 languages. For OLMo models it is mixed.
And while multilingual NLP literature continuously finds that lower cross-lingual alignment is worse for cross-lingual transfer ( Cao et al., 2020 ; Deshpande et al., 2022 ; Gaschi et al., 2023 ; Lim et al., 2025 ; Bandarkar et al., 2026b ) , we do not claim that this lower alignment is bad. It is conceivable, even if unlikely, that recurrent attention simply requires lower alignment for equivalent transfer.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,Granite-H的表示结构明显不统一,特别是在中层。 这一数字显示为多种语言的平均数,但对所有13种语言来说都是如此。 对于Quen模型,Quen3.5在10/13语言中的交叉语言对齐较少. 对于Ring来说,Ring-linear在11/13语言中的对齐度较低. 对于OLMo模型,它是混合的.
而多语言的NLP文献不断发现,跨语言比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比 可以想象,即使不可能,经常性的注意只是要求降低对等转让的调整。

blocks.en: Finding 3 Hybrid LLMs specifically organize multilingual processing based on the layer ordering, with abrupt changes in cross-lingual metrics around full attention layers.
blocks.zh: Find 3 Hybrid LLMs 专门组织基于图层顺序的多语种处理,全注意力层周围的跨语言度量标准突变.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Visualization of the jagged curves in the hybrid models (right), which seem to reflect the heterogeneous attention layout, compared with the smoother curves in non-hybrid counterparts(left).
blocks.zh: 图3 混合模型(右)中标记曲线的可视化,这似乎反映了不同的注意布局,与非hybrid对应物(左)中较平滑的曲线相比.

blocks.en:
The most notable consistent pattern we identify is that SoftCKA reveals homogeneous LLMs smoothly build shared representations and then undo them before generation while hybrid LLMs experience many abrupt changes every time a full attention layer comes around. This difference is consistent across all 4 model pairs, 2 of which are shown in Figure 3 .
Specifically, in agreement with Finding 2, the representations get more aligned before each full attention block.
blocks.zh:
我们发现的最显著的一致模式是SoftCKA揭示了同质的LLMS平稳地构建了共同的表达方式,然后在一代人之前解除它们,而混合的LLMS则在每出现一个完整的关注层时都会经历许多突然的变化. 在所有4对模型中,这一差异是一致的,其中2对见图3。
具体地说,与 " 调查结果2 " 一致,在各充分关注块之前,陈述内容更加一致。

blocks.en: Finding 4 A major cross-lingual event occurs at first full attention layer
blocks.zh: 发现 4 一个主要的跨语言事件,首先在全注意力层发生

blocks.en: Figure 4: SoftCKA scores of the attention block delta . Curiously, the major “event” at the first full attention layer is opposite to other models.
blocks.zh: 图4:SoftCKA在注意力区三角洲的分数 奇怪的是,第一个完全关注层的主要“活动”与其他模型相反。

blocks.en: We also identify that the most abrupt spike happens at the first full attention layer. This is consistent across all hybrid models in the four pairs and additionally Ling-2.6-flash.
blocks.zh: 我们还发现,最突然的猛增发生在第一个全注意力层。 这在四对中的所有混合型号以及附加的Ling-2.6-flash中都是一致的.

blocks.en: As a secondary metric, we also calculate the SoftCKA of the output of the attention block, attn_delta , which measures the cross-lingual similarity of a block’s contribution to the residual stream 1 1 1 Note: with the residual connection, the block output attn_delta is just attn_out - attn_in . This metric most dramatically shows that for Qwen3.5, OLMo-Hybrid, and Granite-H, the hidden state transformation in the first full attention block is very aligned across languages relative to layers around it. Very curiously, for Ring and Ling-2.6-flash, there is a large negative spike instead, meaning the full attention block contribution is less similar across languages (Figure 4 ). Because of this inconsistency, we resort to using the vague term “event”. Regardless, it is clear that the LLMs are markedly organizing around this layer. We also find that the preceding MLP and attention blocks progressively prepare inputs for this, see Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 作为次要的衡量标准,我们还计算了注意块输出的SoftCKA,atn_delta,它测量一个块对剩余流的贡献的跨语言相似性 11 1 注: 与剩余连接,块输出的atn_delta只是tn_out - attn_in. 这个度量最显著地表明,对于Quen3.5,OLMo-Hybrid,以及Granite-H来说,第一个完全关注区块中隐藏的状态变换相对于周围的地层,在语言之间非常一致. 非常令人好奇的是,对于Ring和Ling-2.6-flash来说,反之则有较大的负突起,意思是全注意力块在各语言间的贡献不太相似(图4). 由于这种不一致,我们使用模糊的“活动”一词。 无论如何,很明显,法学硕士是围绕这一层组织起来的。 我们还发现,前面的MLP和注意块逐步为此准备了投入,见附录E。

blocks.en: Finding 5 Hybridization with SWA does not lead to such a representational re-organization
blocks.zh: 调查结果5 与西澳大利亚州合并不会导致这种代表性重组

blocks.en: Instead of recurrent attention hybrids, many modern LLMs address long-context efficiency by using sliding window attention (SWA) layers. We repeat the above visualizations for the SWA-hybrid models Tiny Aya Global and OLMo-3. The abrupt changes occurring at full-attention layers, particularly at the first, are absent; see Appendix F . Across various metrics, we find no noticeable pattern different than full-attention LLMs. We conclude that the inductive biases of SWA are not different enough to prompt the reorganization observed in LLMs that interleave recurrent layers.
blocks.zh: 许多现代的LLMs通过使用滑动窗口注意层(SWA)来解决长文本效率问题,而不是经常性的注意混合. 我们为SWA-hybrid模型Tiny Aya Global和OLMo-3重复上述可视化. 在全心全意的层次上,特别是在第一层次上发生的突然变化是不存在的;见附录F。 从各种衡量标准来看,我们发现没有明显模式与全方位有限责任公司不同。 我们的结论是,银河系的诱导性偏差并不不同,不足以促使人们发现LLMs中存在反复层的重组。

blocks.en: Finding 6 Irrespective of language, token attribution shows full attention attends more locally in hybrid models than typical attention layers in non-hybrid models.
blocks.zh: 发现6 不论语言如何,符号归属显示在杂交模型中充分关注的地方比在非杂交模型中典型的关注层更关注.

blocks.en: We study how global or local attention is across different layers. Full attention, by definition, produces a masked matrix 𝑨 = 𝑸 ​ 𝑲 T / d k {\bm{A}}=\displaystyle{\bm{Q}}{\bm{K}}^{T}/\sqrt{d_{k}} that can serve as an explanation of what previous tokens influenced the current. There are methods proposed to re-compose this matrix in recurrent attention via unrolling ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , but comparing cross-architecture is unreliable. As a result, we simply compare the full attention layers and find that the few full attention layers in hybrid models devote a larger proportion of their attention to the most recent tokens (in comparison to full attention layers in non-hybrid models). And even though token attribution from the attention matrix alone may not be entirely faithful ( Modarressi et al., 2023 ; Modarressi et al., 2022 ) , we find this to be very consistent across models and all languages, and not layer-dependent. This could suggest hybrid models reserve local tasks to full attention, which is not necessarily a contradiction to the established notion that full attention takes care of long-range exact retrieval ( Afendulev et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Because of these findings, primarily 3, 4, and 6, we hypothesize that another layer ordering may better facilitate the abstraction of multilingual inputs into language-independent representations.
blocks.zh: 由于这些调查结果,主要是3、4和6,我们假设,另一层顺序可能更有利于将多语种投入抽象化为语言独立的表述。

blocks.en: 6 Hybrid Distillation Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 混合蒸馏实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Related Work on Full Attention Placement
blocks.zh: 6.1 充分关注安置的相关工作

blocks.en: How and where to interleave attention-layer types remains poorly understood: frontier labs almost never disclose the rationale for their architectural choices, beyond noting that the ratio is empirically optimized ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Qwen Team, 2025 ; Ling Team et al., 2025a ) . Periodic interleaving has been justified by the notion that it allows the model regular, exact access to previous tokens ( Dao and Gu, 2024a ; Ren et al., 2025 ) , though this was on Mamba hybrids specifically. Separately, Team et al. (2025) argues that periodic interleaving simplifies KV-cache management.
blocks.zh: 如何和在何处互放关注层类型仍然不甚了解:前沿实验室几乎从未披露其建筑选择的理由,除了注意到该比例在经验上得到了优化外(Wang等人,2026年;Quen Team,2025年;Ling) Team等人,2025a) . 定期互换的理由是,它允许模式定期、精确地访问以前的代号(Dao and Gu, 2024a;Ren等人, 2025年),尽管这是Mamba混合体。 分开来 Team等人(2025年)认为,定期互换简化了KV-cache管理.

blocks.en: Within periodic blocks, the status quo seems to be recurrent attention before full (N:1 instead of 1:N). Waleffe et al. (2024) notes that starting with Mamba means later layers don’t need positional embeddings. Yang et al. (2025d) tests numerous orderings and ends up placing full attention last in their repeating block. Meanwhile, broader experiments from distillation works result in diverse conclusions ( Yang et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . Given this limited research and the fact that it is quite unlikely multilingual considerations were taken into account, we experiment with multilingual data in controlled layer placements.
blocks.zh: 在周期性区块内,现状似乎在满分前反复引起注意(N:1而不是1:N). 华尔夫等人. (2024年)指出,从曼巴开始意味着后层不需要位置嵌入. 杨等. (2025d)测试无数订单,最后在重复块中将全部注意力放在最后. 同时,从蒸馏工作中进行的更广泛的实验得出了不同的结论(Yang等人,2025c;Li等人,2026b;Gu等人,2025;Xia等人,2026). 鉴于这种有限的研究,以及考虑到这种可能性不大的多语种因素,我们在控制层位置上试验多语种数据。

blocks.en: 6.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
Hybrid models can be pretrained from scratch, but are often distilled from a homogeneous teacher model for resource-efficiency ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Xia et al., 2026 ) , such as Ring-Linear.
We run experiments distilling from two small full attention models, Qwen3-4B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) and (secondarily) Granite-4.1-3B ( IBM Research, 2026 ) based on the RADLADS ( Goldstein et al., 2026 ) and HALO ( Chen et al., 2026 ) methods. For further efficiency, we mostly adopt the student initialization method from HALO. We start by converting select layers to Gated DeltaNet,
inheriting the query, key, value, and output projections from the teacher’s full attention of the corresponding layers. Parameters without a counterpart in the teacher are initialized randomly. We then train the whole student to match the frozen teacher’s next-token distribution under KL-divergence D KL D_{\mathrm{KL}} . Unlike RADLADS and HALO, we skip the preliminary stage that trains each converted layer to reproduce the hidden states of the attention layer it replaces as this would undermine our comparisons.
Training only on the output distribution allows the student of hybrid attention structure to organize multilingual processing according to its layer ordering.
We otherwise follow the training recipes and hyperparameters of RADLADS and HALO closely (with minor adjustments for a D KL D_{\mathrm{KL}} -only setup) as we lack the resources for tuning. They are detailed in Appendix C.2 .

blocks.en: The training data is the highly multilingual, specifically FineWeb2 ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) . We set aside 1000 documents for validation and 1000 for test set in each language (52K total). See full data mix details in Appendix C.1 . We limit training runs to 1B tokens and report two main metrics: D KL D_{\mathrm{KL}} to the teacher and cross-entropy loss ℒ LM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}} . In particular, we discuss the ℒ LM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}} gap from the teacher’s ℒ LM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}} , which is, in theory, the upper bound of the student’s modeling performance.

blocks.en:
We fix the ratio of full attention layers to be 25% (9/36 layers in Qwen3-4B’s and 10/40 for Granite-4.1-3B) and vary only where these go. We provide a convenient visualization of the different placements in Figure 5 which we verbalize here.
We term the baseline layout, in which full attention closes each block of four layers, standard periodic . Reverse periodic is the smallest-change variant to it: full attention opens each block instead, which moves every full-attention layer three positions earlier and keeps the general block-interleaving pattern the same.
The other three placements are non-periodic. Sandwich , the most extreme, clusters all full-attention layers at the first and last layers. Interleaved sandwich keeps two-thirds of them at the ends and spread the rest periodically in the middle, and endpoint spread places full attention in the first and last layers and spaces the remaining layers evenly in between.
The four alternatives differ from one another in many ways, but unlike standard periodic , all of them use full attention in the first layer.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Open Questions
blocks.zh: 7. 结论和未决问题

blocks.en:
This work provides the first analysis of the interaction between hybrid attention architectures and multilinguality.
We identify two concrete takeaways for model developers. First, multilingual LLMs should use hybrid attention because of the massive efficiency gains with minimal performance cost on long multilingual sequences. Second, our experimental setting suggests that LLMs learn multilingual data significantly better if the first decoder layer uses full attention. While our experiments display major training performance differences, it is, after all, distillation training on 1B tokens on small LLMs with one recurrent architecture. Regardless, our resource-limited conditions clearly prompts the theory that multilingual LLMs should start with full attention.
blocks.zh:
这项工作首先分析了混合关注架构与多语种之间的相互作用。
我们为模型开发者确定了两个混凝土外卖项目。 首先,多语种有限责任公司应利用混合关注,因为长期多语种序列的性能成本最低,效率大。 第二,我们的实验环境表明,如果第一个解码层充分注意的话,LLMs学习多语言数据要好得多。 虽然我们的实验显示出了重大的训练性能差异,但毕竟,它是在1B符号上的蒸馏训练,它是一个经常性的建筑。 无论如何,我们资源有限的状况显然促使人们相信,多语种法学硕士应当从充分关注开始。

blocks.en: Beyond this, Section 5 generally identifies that the hybridization of the attention blocks leads to some sort of representational reorganization. However, a mechanistic explanation of what is actually occurring remains an open question. In general, mechanistic explanations remain an inhibitive challenge in LLM interpretability ( Hendrycks and Hiscott, 2024 ; Sharkey et al., 2025 ; Nanda et al., 2025 ) . For now, we can conclude that the inductive bias of each block matters and that the LLMs learn to reserve some sort of multilingual-relevant task for full attention layers.
blocks.zh: 除此之外,第5节一般认为,注意力块的混合导致某种代表性重组。 然而,对实际发生情况的一种机械解释仍然是一个未决问题。 一般来说,机械解释仍然是LLM可解释性中的一个抑制性挑战(Hendrycks and Hiscott, 2024;Sharkey等人, 2025;Nanda等人, 2025)。 目前,我们可以得出结论,每个块事项的诱导性偏差,以及法学硕士学习将某种与多种语言有关的任务保留给充分关注层。

blocks.en: The first step of our analysis was to evaluate the pairs of hybrid/non-hybrid models on multilingual benchmarks. We evaluate the four model pairs on MGSM ( Shi et al., 2023 ) , MMLU ProX ( Xuan et al., 2025 ) , Belebele ( Bandarkar et al., 2024 ) , and Global-PIQA ( Chang et al., 2025 ) . However, as discussed in Section 3 , comparisons are severely limited by the lack of controlled comparability and transparency into model development. We therefore evaluate performance relative to English as a measure of cross-lingual transfer. The results are noisy and inconsistent across models, so we do not report them in detail because the investigation was inconclusive.

blocks.en: For each language, we fix a canonical document order by shuffling its FineWeb-2 stream (shard order and a 2,000-document buffer) with a seed held constant across all runs. The first 2,000 documents in this order are never trained on: documents 1–1,000 form the validation set, evaluated every 10 7 10^{7} training tokens, and documents 1,001–2,000 form the test set, evaluated once after training. Because this reservation does not depend on a run’s data seed, all runs with the same teacher are scored on identical validation and test token sequences. Training data are drawn from the remaining documents: the data seed reshuffles each language’s remaining stream and the order in which languages are interleaved in the training set, so different seeds train on largely different documents. The only exception is Mon, whose 340 remaining documents are reused unchanged.

blocks.en: Our primary metric looks at the hidden state entering each layer, attn_in . However, we find that a slight modification reveals interesting results. As discussed in Section 5.2 , we also calculate SoftCKA of the residual-stream contribution of each block. Since this treats the block as a black box, it is comparable across various attention blocks and even the MLP block. In Figure 1 , these values are attn_delta and mlp_delta .
blocks.zh: 我们的首要衡量标准是进入每一层的隐藏状态。 然而,我们发现,稍作修改后,结果令人感兴趣。 正如第5.2节所讨论的那样,我们还计算每个区块的剩余流贡献的SoftCKA。 由于这把块当作一个黑匣子处理,因此在各种关注块甚至MLP块之间可以比较. 在图1中,这些值是atn_delta和mlp_delta 。

blocks.en: Appendix G MoE Routing Alignment
blocks.zh: 附录G 教育部路线调整

blocks.en: For the mixture-of-experts Qwen and Ring model pairs, we compute the routing-divergence metric of Bandarkar et al. (2026b) . The metric measures cross-lingual MoE routing agreement at the sequence level using parallel sentences. For each sequence, the router weights are mean-pooled across tokens and then we take the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the resulting distributions for the two languages. We apply this metric to parallel samples from FloRES ( NLLB Team et al., 2022 ) and report corpus-wide averages at each layer. Lower JS divergence indicates more similar expert-routing behavior across languages.
blocks.zh: 对于混合专家Quen和Ring模型配对,我们计算Bandarkar等人(2026年b)的路由-潜水量度。 计量标准使用平行句子,在序列层次上跨语言的教育部路由协议. 对于每个序列,路由器的权重被平均集合到符号之间,然后我们拿Jensen-Shannon在两种语言产生的分布之间的偏差. 我们对FloRES(NLLB Team等人,2022年)的平行样本采用这一指标,并报告每层的全体平均值。 联合来文的差别较小,表明不同语言的专家路线行为更为相似。

blocks.en: Figures G.1 - G.4 show the layer-wise results. In the hybrid models, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Ring-mini-linear-2.0, routing divergence remains relatively flat through the initial recurrent layers and begins to decrease only after the first full-attention layer. By contrast, divergence begins decreasing immediately in the non-hybrid Qwen3-30B-A3B and Ring-mini-2.0 models.
